title: Born in Algiers: the family homes
summary: Born 7 Feb 1896 in Algiers; he gives his street addresses and describes the house with its cupola damaged in the 1915 storm.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: how did you get your birth date down exactly and where you were born
I was born in Algiers New Orleans Louisiana on uh May on uh February the 7th 1896 and that puts me in the age bracket
well uh what part of Algiers exactly

at uh 232 Verrett street uh then uh then I later lived on Olivia street and then on Delaron street 407 Delaron street we uh had a very nice place there where we could sit up on the roof at times and look at the boats coming into the river

I had a cupola cupola as we always called it and uh however the storm 1915 storm uh blew the top in and they didn't have the cupola fixed over they just roofed the roofed it over the home there but uh I look back with uh lots of enjoyment on my youth on my childhood days in Algiers uh my dad always wanted the boys over we'd we had a double parlors in our home and he was always getting the gang in dad go and whistle and they'd all come over and from from the from the drugstore corner in those days you used to stand on the corner it was time to make up your minds where you wanted to go that evening and uh sometimes you'd get the gang in we'd play games and uh dad would have prizes for the one who danced the best or played the best tune and we'd make make these old edison records the old cylinder records and he had a uh special recorder and a horn for it and it was something in those days and the drummer would be uh a couple of lead pencils on the horn uh we did have good times though even depending the tail on the donkey for prizes but those were uh and my sister lillian and uh my three sisters and a brother mother and father and myself we all played piano and uh i have always played piano as far back as i can remember not that i'm so good but i uh
